chunks: 5394 - Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah and Husayn al-Rawwasi, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام: A woman fears pregnancy, so she drinks medicine and casts out what is in her womb. He said: "No."
So I said: It is only a drop of fluid. He said: "Indeed, the first thing that is created is a drop of fluid."

key_terms.الدَّوَاءَ: medicine taken as a treatment or agent
key_terms.نُطْفَةٌ: a drop of fluid; the earliest stage of human creation

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام say about using medicine to abort a pregnancy at the nutfah stage?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling against a woman taking medicine to expel what is in her womb out of fear of pregnancy. The Imam عليه السلام rejects the objection that it is only a nutfah, affirming that the beginning of creation starts from the nutfah stage.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5394 - Al-Husayn ibn Said narrated from Ibn Abi Umayr from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah and Husayn Al-Rawwasi from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan (as) about a woman who fears pregnancy and drinks medicine to cause a miscarriage.
Imam (as) replied: "No."
I said: "It is only a drop of fluid (nutfah)."
Imam (as) said: "Indeed, the first stage of creation is a drop of fluid (nutfah)."
